```python
def solve(case):
    capacity = case['capacity']
    trials = case['trials']
    memory = {}  # signature -> dict
    signatures = []  # list of unique signatures in order of first appearance
    seen = set()
    for i, trial in enumerate(trials):
        sig = trial['signature']
        ref = trial['reflection']
        suc = trial['success']
        if sig not in seen:
            seen.add(sig)
            signatures.append(sig)
        if sig in memory:
            # update existing
            memory[sig]['last_trial'] = i
            memory[sig]['reflection'] = ref
            memory[sig]['success'] = suc
        else:
            # add new
            memory[sig] = {
                'last_trial': i,
                'reflection': ref,
                'signature': sig,
                'success': suc
            }
        # evict if over capacity
        if len(memory) > capacity:
            # find oldest (smallest last_trial)
            oldest_sig = min(memory, key=lambda s: memory[s]['last_trial'])
            del memory[oldest_sig]
    # convert memory to list
    memory_list = list(memory.values())
    return {
        'memory': memory_list,
        'signatures': signatures
    }
```
